notes.title: CastleMiner Warfare Launches on Steam Today!
notes.content:
We have brought CastleMiner Warfare to you on Steam and it launches today at 1 PM PDT!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/675210/CastleMiner_Warfare/?beta=0

CastleMiner Warfare is a competitive FPS with modern day firearms. It takes place on block based maps that are completely build-able and destructible. While playing you can freely switch between build mode and fight mode allowing you to build fortifications in the heat of battle. In addition there is a free build map mode where you can build your own maps, host and distribute them online.

During your battles you will gain points for kills and progress through a series of ranks, unlocking new weapons, equipment, and blocks to place.

Our fluid dynamics simulator, simulates fire, flammable oil, flowing lava, water, ice, and explosives. These materials flow through the map and interact with each other creating interesting challenges during battle. Imagine ambushing your enemy by blasting open an oil tank next to a fire, and engulfing half the map in flames.

notes.title: 1.9.8 is Live
notes.content:
Aliens and Hell Lord Spawners are here!

* Spawn blocks can be found randomly in the world. They are most common in Scavenger mode.
* Spawners generate enemies once you activate them with right click.
* There are 3 types of blocks found in caves: Basic Zombie, Dangerous Zombie and Alien spawners.
* Hell spawners can be found on the floors of the Hell Biome. 
* A powerful Hell Lord will be summoned -- Larger and tougher than the normal version!
* Overall spawner logic has been improved. 
* Spawners will reset if you run too far from the monsters.
* Earn loot blocks for clearing spawners.

We plan to shift focus to some more popular requests in upcoming updates - ones that fit into our available resources. We also would like to use spawners for some other content in the future. For now, we hope you enjoy some harder encounters!

notes.title: Beta 1.9.7.8 - A small but important fix for teleport stations.
notes.content:
Some players found previously placed teleport stations were disappointingly converted into monster spawners. 

This patch fixes that by returning them to their true state. All blocks that were originally teleport stations before patch 1.9.7.7 will again work as expected. Your saved worlds should be automatically repaired when you next load them.

No other blocks should be affected in any way. We're going to keep this as a beta build for a couple days to validate the fix.

Let us know if you experience any issues with the Beta build!

Thank you to those that reported this issue. We appreciate your help and understanding!

notes.title: Update 1.9.7.7 is live! Conquer Monster Spawners!
notes.content:
Spawn Blocks are randomly generated throughout the world. Waves of enemies will arise from any block after it is activated.

* Spawn Blocks are most common in Scavenger Mode, but they can be found in Explorer mode and rarely in Survival mode.
* Spawn blocks come in two forms: Grey (easy) and Red (challenging) 
* Right click on a spawn block to activate it. 
* Active blocks will light up and begin flashing. 
* Waves of skeletons and zombies will arise from the block. 
* If you defeat all the enemies, the spawn block transforms into a loot block. 
* If two (or more) spawn blocks are in close proximity, they might cause a chain reaction and all activate! 

[Bug Fix] Corrected an issue that prevented players from harvesting their own teleport blocks.
[Misc Fixes] Some other minor fixes for bugs not yet reported by players.

Spawn blocks are a step towards more advanced challenges. We'll be exploring those possibilities (including Alien and Demon spawners) while we look into player requests for upcoming features.

notes.title: Update 1.9.7 is out. Try out Teleport Stations and Iron Doors!
notes.content:
Teleport Stations are expensive-to-build blocks that allow players to create a network of outposts they can teleport between. We envision this as a long term goal that will hopefully make lesser ingredients such as copper and rock continue to matter. There are 3 different recipes to give flexibility in constructing teleports.

Each player must build their own teleport stations as each block is encoded to the builder. Only the builder can dig them up and move them to a new location. You need to place 2 teleport blocks to be able to benefit from this technology. 

Other Changes: 
- By popular demand, Dust has been removed from digging. 
- By even more popular demand, we bring you: Iron Doors! 
- Ore now stacks up to 255. No more 64 stack limits. 
- We're experimenting with a slightly larger explosion radius on regular Rockets. 

Loot Block Balancing: 
- Reduced the number of drops per lucky loot block.
- Reduced the spawn frequency of lucky loot blocks. 
- Reduced the drop rate of the better guns. 
- Downgraded the Bloodstone LMG drop to Diamond LMG.

notes.title: Loot blocks! Update 1.9.6 is available for beta testing!
notes.content:
UPDATE: 

We've modified Loot Blocks based on everyone's feedback. We'll do another short beta pass to get further feedback before this goes live.

- Added Scavenger mode with high frequency loot blocks (similar to 1.9.6)
- Survival and Exploration mode loot blocks have been reduced as follows:
  * Loot blocks will not spawn on surface sand or snow.
  * Lucky Loot blocks only spawn deeper under ground or at very high altitudes (sky islands)
  * You should find loot blocks are much rarer now. Perhaps too rare!

- Loot Block glow reduced by 50%.
- Loot Blocks do not spawn in Endurance/Dragon Endurance mode.
- Creative Mode uses the Scavenger mode settings for now.
- Lucky Loot blocks give 1 less loot.
- Lucky Loot blocks require a Gold pickaxe to open.
- Rare item frequency has been reduced.
- Diamond guns have been replaced by Gold guns in the loot table.

The changes really comes down letting people who like the old challenge use Survival mode and people who love loot hunting the new way can play Scavenger mode. We'll adjust these further (and expand the loot tables) in future updates.

More feedback is encouraged!

---------------------

Loot blocks are scattered randomly through the world. Break open blue blocks for a random item. Seek out the rarer golden blocks for piles of loot.

There's only one way to find out what's inside! Well, aside from using lasers and explosions, of course.

For testing feedback, we need to determine if the drop rates feel good, and which game modes are appropriate for loot blocks.  

Please let us know what you think!

-  We also fixed spawn beacons to work underground.

notes.title: Update 1.9.5 is live. Use stamina to sprint and double jump!
notes.content:
Our stamina/energy system is finally here!

- Hold Left Shift to sprint. 
- Jump a second time while in air to go further!
- Stamina cannot be used in either Endurance mode.
- If you go to 0% stamina, there is a short recovery before you can use stamina again.

We will be expanding upon the uses of stamina in future builds. We will also be looking into features that let you improve your sprint duration, regeneration rate, and so forth.

notes.title: Update 1.9.4 is in Beta - Sprint and Double Jump added!
notes.content:
This update introduces our first pass at a Stamina system.

- Hold Shift to Sprint. You can rebind this key in the Options menu.
- Press Space after jumping to jump a second time. 
- A carefully timed double jump can avoid or reduce fall damage.
- There is a short cooldown on using stamina once you reach 0%.
- Taking damage also triggers a short cooldown on regenerating stamina.
- Increased the distance you can fall without taking damage to support double jump heights.

Please give us feedback before we go live with this change. Particularly if it seems to have a negative impact on PvP or certain game modes. The goal is for the extra movement to make the game more fun and, of course, there are future plans for more ways to use Stamina.

notes.title: 1.6.3.7 Now in beta, 1.6.3.6 now live
notes.content:
Hi guys,

I just moved 1.6.3.6 to the main branch, and uploaded 1.6.3.7 to beta. 

The new version fixes the following issues:

[list]
[*]Save games and settings disappearing when steam profile name changes
[*]Chat in the wrong place
[*]Player continues moving if chat is raised while movement key is held down
[/list]

The first time you run 1.6.3.7, it will rewrite all the save games to remove the dependence on the profile name. 

We've tested this and it appears completely safe, but of course that's what we said about thalidomide.

If you are nervous about losing your data, do the following:
    1) go to %AppData%\..\Local\CastleMinerZ
    2) Zip (or otherwise archive) or copy the directory with the long number for a name.

If, for some reason, the new update messes up your data, you can always restore it from your copy.

We're currently working on supporting other resolutions, key binding, voice chat and more.

Thanks for your generous patience,

-john

notes.title: Update 1.6.3.6 Now available on beta branch
notes.content:
Hi guys,

Thank you for being so patient as we work through our teething pains.

1.6.3.6 is live in the beta branch. A lot of code changed, so I want to let it simmer in beta for a day before putting it on the main branch (you know, [i]in case there are any bugs[/i]).

I realize a lot of you have had a very inconsistent multiplayer experience, but this fix will be a big improvement.

Here's what got addressed:
[list]
[*]Added Chat (on the "t" key)
[*]Added "Search again" button to online session chooser to look for new sessions
[*]Sessions in the session chooser are now always sorted by the column, and then by the proximity of the server to you (as reported by steam). Games earlier in the list will be closer than games later in the list.
[*]Session chooser now shows more sessions (although latency may be high on the ones at the bottom).
[*]Fixed crashes in session chooser screen
[*]Fixed mysterious "Host Disconnected" message when trying to join an online game.
[*]Fixed endless connecting screen when joining an online game
[*]Connection chooser now sorts by number of friends playing by default.
[*]Added more descriptive error messages when trying to join a game
[*]Removed "Hosted by: [unknown]" when steam won't tell us who the host is.
[/list]

[b]Additional Information[/b]:
There are some cases when a game will not show up in the session list:
[list]
[*]If the host has not set their Steam presence to "Online".
[*]In an Endurance game, if anyone has gone past 100 meters, or has been playing more than 1 in-game day the game issues a message stating that no one else can join, and the game will no longer show up in the session chooser.
[*]If the host has marked the game as "Invited Friends Only" in Host Settings/Who can join, you won't see it. Also if Who can join is set to "Friends Only", only friends of the host will see the game.
[*]Sometimes games may not be visible if the host is running a different version than you are. We try to minimize this.
[/list]

Also, I wanted to point out that if your friends are playing, you can join their game by going to the Steam Friends panel, right clicking on your friend and choosing "Join Game" (this still won't work if they are in an Endurance game that is no longer joinable).

Finally, there are many reasons why you may not be able to connect to a game. Steam has a bunch of reasons related to blocking and clans and so forth. I've made the error message much more clear, so you should at least know why you couldn't connect.

Ok, this has gone on long enough. 
Thank you again, for your patience, and if there are no problems with the beta, look for it to go live tomorrow around this time.

-john

[*]Added Chat (on the "t" key)
[*]Added "Search again" button to online session chooser to look for new sessions
[*]Sessions in the session chooser are now always sorted by the column, and then by the proximity of the server to you (as reported by steam). Games earlier in the list will be closer than games later in the list.
[*]Session chooser now shows more sessions (although latency may be high on the ones at the bottom).
[*]Fixed crashes in session chooser screen
[*]Fixed mysterious "Host Disconnected" message when trying to join an online game.
[*]Fixed endless connecting screen when joining an online game
[*]Connection chooser now sorts by number of friends playing by default.
[*]Added more descriptive error messages when trying to join a game
[*]Removed "Hosted by: [unknown]" when steam won't tell us who the host is.
[/list]

[b]Additional Information[/b]:
There are some cases when a game will not show up in the session list:
[list]
[*]If the host has not set their Steam presence to "Online".
[*]In an Endurance game, if anyone has gone past 100 meters, or has been playing more than 1 in-game day the game issues a message stating that no one else can join, and the game will no longer show up in the session chooser.
[*]If the host has marked the game as "Invited Friends Only" in Host Settings/Who can join, you won't see it. Also if Who can join is set to "Friends Only", only friends of the host will see the game.
[*]Sometimes games may not be visible if the host is running a different version than you are. We try to minimize this.
[/list]

Also, I wanted to point out that if your friends are playing, you can join their game by going to the Steam Friends panel, right clicking on your friend and choosing "Join Game" (this still won't work if they are in an Endurance game that is no longer joinable).

Finally, there are many reasons why you may not be able to connect to a game. Steam has a bunch of reasons related to blocking and clans and so forth. I've made the error message much more clear, so you should at least know why you couldn't connect.

Ok, this has gone on long enough. 
Thank you again, for your patience, and if there are no problems with the beta, look for it to go live tomorrow around this time.

-john
